info.name: Article API
info.description:
# Article API

Base URL: `{{baseUrl}}`

## Authentication

Cac API (tru `/api/auth/**`) can header:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```

Chay **Login** hoac **Register** truoc de tu dong luu `token`.

## Khoa binh luan (`lockComment`)

Moi bai viet co field `lockComment` (boolean, mac dinh `false`):

| Gia tri | Y nghia |
|---------|--------|
| `false` | Cho phep nguoi khac comment |
| `true` | Khoa comment — nguoi khong phai chu bai khong the them comment moi |

- Chi **chu bai viet** duoc bat/tat khi **tao** hoac **sua** bai (POST/PUT `/api/articles`).
- Chu bai van co the comment khi bai da khoa.
- GET danh sach/chi tiet bai viet tra ve `lockComment`.
- GET comment cu van hoat dong khi bai da khoa.
- POST comment khi bi khoa (khong phai chu bai): **400** — `"Bai viet da khoa binh luan"`.

## HTTP Status Codes

| Code | Meaning | Use case |
|------|---------|----------|
| 200 | OK | GET, PUT thanh cong |
| 201 | Created | Register, tao article/comment |
| 204 | No Content | Xoa article |
| 400 | Bad Request | Validation loi / bai viet da khoa binh luan |
| 401 | Unauthorized | Chua dang nhap / sai token |
| 403 | Forbidden | Khong phai chu bai viet (sua/xoa) |
| 404 | Not Found | Khong tim thay resource |
| 409 | Conflict | Trung email/username |
| 500 | Server Error | Loi he thong |

## Error Response

```json
{
  "code": 403,
  "message": "Ban khong co quyen thao tac bai viet nay"
}
```

Validation (400) co them field `errors`:

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Validation / bad request",
  "errors": { "title": "Title is required" }
}
```

Khoa binh luan (400):

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Bai viet da khoa binh luan"
}
```

item.name: Auth
item.description: Dang ky va dang nhap. Tra ve JWT token.

request.description:
**POST** `/api/auth/login`

**Auth:** Khong can

**Body:** email, password

**Response 200:** token, email, username

**Errors:** 401 sai email/password

item.name: User
item.description: Quan ly thong tin user dang nhap.

request.description:
**PUT** `/api/users/me`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Body:** username (chi duoc sua username)

**Response 200:** UserResponse

**Errors:** 400, 401, 409 trung username

item.name: Articles
item.description:
Quan ly bai viet. Home chi hien title + description; chi tiet co full content.

Field `lockComment` (boolean): khoa binh luan cho nguoi khac. Mac dinh `false`.

request.description:
**GET** `/api/articles`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Response 200:** Danh sach summary

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "title": "Bai viet 1",
    "description": "Mo ta ngan",
    "tag": "java",
    "lockComment": false,
    "authorUsername": "testuser"
  }
]
```

**GET** `/api/articles/{id}`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "title": "Bai viet mau",
  "description": "Mo ta ngan",
  "content": "Noi dung day du...",
  "tag": "springboot",
  "lockComment": false,
  "authorUsername": "testuser",
  "createdAt": "2026-05-22T10:00:00",
  "updatedAt": "2026-05-22T10:00:00"
}
```

**Errors:** 404

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Bai viet mau",
  "description": "Mo ta ngan ve bai viet",
  "content": "Noi dung day du cua bai viet...",
  "tag": "springboot",
  "lockComment": false
}

request.description:
**POST** `/api/articles`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Mo ta |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| title | string | yes | Tieu de |
| description | string | yes | Mo ta ngan |
| content | string | yes | Noi dung |
| tag | string | yes | Tag |
| lockComment | boolean | no | Khoa binh luan (mac dinh `false`) |

**Response 201:** ArticleResponse (co `lockComment`)

**Errors:** 400 validation, 401

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Bai viet da sua",
  "description": "Mo ta moi",
  "content": "Noi dung moi...",
  "tag": "java",
  "lockComment": true
}

request.description:
**PUT** `/api/articles/{id}`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Quyen:** Chi chu bai viet

**Body:** giong Create Article, bao gom `lockComment` de bat/tat khoa binh luan.

Vi du body co `"lockComment": true` de khoa comment cua nguoi khac.

**Response 200:** ArticleResponse

**Errors:** 400, 401, 403, 404

**DELETE** `/api/articles/{id}`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Quyen:** Chi chu bai viet

**Response 204:** No Content

**Errors:** 401, 403, 404

item.name: Comments
item.description:
Binh luan bai viet.

- Moi user da dang nhap deu co the comment neu bai **chua khoa** (`lockComment: false`).
- Neu bai da khoa (`lockComment: true`): chi **chu bai** duoc comment; nguoi khac nhan **400**.
- Van xem duoc comment cu (GET) khi bai da khoa.

request.description:
**GET** `/api/articles/{id}/comments`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Response 200:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "content": "Binh luan hay!",
    "authorUsername": "testuser",
    "createdAt": "2026-05-22T10:00:00"
  }
]
```

**Errors:** 404 bai viet khong ton tai

**POST** `/api/articles/{id}/comments`

**Auth:** Bearer token

**Body:** content

**Response 201:** CommentResponse

**Errors:**
- 400 validation
- 400 bai viet da khoa binh luan (khi `lockComment: true` va nguoi comment khong phai chu bai)
- 401
- 404

**Vi du loi khoa binh luan:**
```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Bai viet da khoa binh luan"
}
```
